reviews.review:
I generally like hidden cats games, including earlier games by Peach Rain. I play them to relax, a kind of zen moment.

But this time? I am just frustrated. Many cats do not have identifiable shapes at all. And worse: without the use of hints, you can use the cats' meowing to get an indication when they are on screen... but the game also has multiple types of collectables, which also mew non stop, so you don't even know if a barely recognisable cat, or a barely recognisable windmill is supposed to be on screen right now!

And on top of that, collectable types must be unlocked in sequence. So for example, you see the outline of a fish and you KNOW it is a collectable, but you have to collect four sets of other items first, before you can collect that fish. And all the time both the unrecognisable cats and the unrecognisable items KEEP MEOWING.

Only get this if your tolerance for too much pixel hunting is higher than mine, and consider turning off all sound for the game.
